steps.en: Open the README and read "Start here" first, in order
steps.zh: 打开 README，先按顺序读完 “Start here” 那 8 条

steps.en: Orders the field from one request to one GPU, then kernels, engines and clusters
steps.zh: 把领域从单次请求排到单卡、算子、引擎、集群

steps.en: Admits only the original paper, the official spec, an implementing repo or a reproducible report
steps.zh: 只收录原始论文、官方规范、实现仓库，或有复现细节的实现者报告

steps.en: Jump to the numbered section that matches today's bottleneck
steps.zh: 跳到与当前瓶颈对应的编号小节
steps.code: 2. Kernel optimization · 4. Inference engines · 5. Distributed inference

steps.en: Open the linked primary source and work it on your own hardware
steps.zh: 打开链接里的原始资料，在自己的机器上动手做

steps.en: Drops performance numbers that lack hardware, workload, precision or baseline
steps.zh: 丢掉缺硬件、负载、精度或基线的性能数字

steps.en: Rejects broken anchors on every PR and re-checks all external links weekly
steps.zh: 每次 PR 拒绝断锚点，每周复查全部外链

value.en: You stop guessing what to learn first and whose explanation to trust — the order and the source bar are already made
value.zh: 不用再猜先学什么、该信谁的解释——顺序和收录标准已经替你定好

sources: README.md → "Read **Start here** first. After that, use it as a reference."
README.md → "The list is ordered from a single inference request to a single GPU, optimized kernels, inference engines, and distributed systems."
README.md → section headings "Start here: the minimum mental model", "2. Kernel optimization", "4. Inference engines", "5. Distributed inference" (the code values are those headings, verbatim)

README.md → "Source policy" ("the paper that introduced the mechanism; the specification or official documentation that defines it; the repository that implements it; a direct implementer report with code, measurements, and enough detail to reproduce")
CONTRIBUTING.md → "Primary means one of the following" + "Do not submit summaries, generic tutorials, marketing pages, broad surveys, or leaderboard claims without a hardened evaluator."

CONTRIBUTING.md → "Performance claims" ("A performance number needs: hardware and software versions; workload shapes or request distribution; precision and algorithm; baseline; correctness method. If any item is missing, omit the number.")
CONTRIBUTING.md → "The automated checks reject broken internal anchors and accidental duplicate links. External links are checked separately"
scripts/check_guide.py + .github/workflows/quality.yml (runs it on every PR) and .github/workflows/links.yml (lychee, cron "17 9 * * 1")
